# Community garden

Our shared plot on the hill has twenty small allotments around a central tool shed. I have number twelve, next to the old fig tree. The association meets on the first Sunday of the month to share the watering rota and to repair the fence.

Parking is difficult, so I come by bicycle with the tools in a basket. The neighbours swap seedlings in spring, and in autumn there is a soup made of whatever the plots produced. Keys for the shed are with the treasurer.
